sources.title: Land contamination: technical guidance
sources.role: Environment Agency collection for land-contamination risk management.
sources.facts: Updated 13 May 2026 and brings together technical guidance for investigating and managing contamination.
sources.guard: Technical guidance does not prove contamination exists or has been remediated at a particular parcel.

sources.title: Land affected by contamination
sources.role: Planning practice guidance for land affected by contamination.
sources.facts: The guidance explains how contamination can be relevant to plan making and development decisions.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not determine Part 2A status, liability, remediation completion or site suitability.

sources.title: Get voluntary remediation advice for contaminated land and groundwater
sources.role: Current Environment Agency voluntary remediation advice service.
sources.facts: Published 3 June 2026 and recommends following Land Contamination Risk Management guidance.
sources.guard: Advice requests and review comments are not regulatory approval, permit grant or confirmation that remediation is complete.

sources.title: Historic Landfill Sites
sources.facts: Updated 15 May 2026 and describes known historic sites where no environmental permit is in force.
sources.guard: Historic landfill boundaries and attributes may be incomplete and do not prove contamination, migration pathways or current condition.

sources.title: Permitted Waste Sites: Authorised Landfill Site Boundaries
sources.role: Current Environment Agency authorised landfill-boundary dataset.
sources.facts: Updated 15 May 2026 and provides boundaries extracted from the current permit system.
sources.guard: A permit-system boundary does not prove current operations, compliance, waste type at a point or absence of off-site effects.

sources.title: Radon Potential for Great Britain version 3
sources.facts: Updated 23 July 2026 and describes the definitive map of Radon Affected Areas in Great Britain.
sources.guard: Mapped radon potential is not a measurement for an individual building and does not prove mitigation requirements or performance.

sources.title: Land stability
sources.role: Planning practice guidance on subsidence, landslides and ground compression.
sources.facts: The guidance advises technical assessment where instability is known or suspected.
sources.guard: General policy does not prove a parcel is stable, buildable or free from mining, landslide or compression hazards.

sources.title: Planning applications and Coal Mining Risk Assessments
sources.role: Mining Remediation Authority guidance for coal-mining risk assessments in planning.
sources.facts: The guidance sets expectations for competent assessment of historical coal-mining hazards.
sources.guard: A requirement or submitted assessment does not prove the site is safe, stable, remediated or approved.
